## 2. In-House Proprietary Slice Suite (ProdX)
Available at https://agenerativeslice.com/products :

### 2.1 Slice3D — Spatial 3D Web Visualizer
- **Purpose**: Interactive, hardware-accelerated 3D product showcase operating directly in modern mobile and desktop web browsers without external plugins, apps, or sluggish loading.
- **Technologies**: WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GLTF/GLB optimization, Blender 3D pipelines.
- **Target Use Cases**: E-commerce luxury goods, architectural scale models, bespoke jewelry, real estate floorplans.

### 2.2 SliceLeads — Autonomous B2B Lead Intelligence
- **Purpose**: Autonomous prospecting engine that extracts and verifies localized business leads, filters out non-operational contacts, cleans phone/WhatsApp data, and generates tailored conversational icebreakers.
- **Technologies**: Python, Playwright, BeautifulSoup, Gemini AI, multi-pass validation algorithms, WhatsApp Web automated dispatchers.

### 2.3 SliceMail — High-Deliverability Outreach Engine
- **Purpose**: Automated email communication platform capable of dispatching 400+ hyper-customized pitches and client updates daily while strictly maintaining SPF, DKIM, and DMARC 100% inbox deliverability.
- **Technologies**: SMTP engines, Zoho Mail APIs, dynamic template injection, spam-score heuristic checks.

### 2.4 SliceInbox — Team Mailbox Chief of Staff
- **Purpose**: Self-hosted inbox intelligence that triages inbound client correspondence, detects urgency and buyer intent, filters cold spam, and drafts contextual response suggestions.
- **Technologies**: FastMCP, Python, IMAP/SMTP workers, LLM categorization pipelines.

### 2.5 SlicePPT — Instant Executive Presentation Generator
- **Purpose**: Transforms unstructured notes, bullet points, spreadsheets, and meeting transcripts into formatted 16:9 widescreen presentation slides.
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, Pandoc, Marp, Tabler UI engines, dynamic SVG vector graphics.

### 2.6 SliceDAM — Centralized Asset & Contract Vault
- **Purpose**: Centralized digital asset management hub that automates System Requirement Notes (SRN), Statements of Work (SOW), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), tax invoices, and legal contracts.
- **Technologies**: React, Node.js, vector jsPDF, cryptographic document signatures.

### 2.7 SliceClass — Monochromatic Academy & Video Studio
- **Purpose**: High-performance learning portal with phone OTP authentication, DRM-protected video streaming, interactive quizzes, and low-latency student progress dashboards.
- **Technologies**: React, Vite, Render API, HLS video streams, PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth.

## 3. Client Case Studies & Production Deliverables
Available at https://agenerativeslice.com/projects :

1. **Sree Ambal Catering** (Hospitality & F&B):
   - Challenge: Unstable network connectivity at remote wedding halls caused banquet stock discrepancies and delayed kitchen dispatch.
   - Solution: Offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) with Firestore caching, multilingual Tamil/English catalog, and instant receipt printing.

2. **Rose Chemicals** (Industrial & Retail):
   - Challenge: Manual telephone and email ordering caused inventory mismatches and administrative backlogs.
   - Solution: Glassmorphic Next.js web portal linked to a 24/7 conversational Sarvam AI WhatsApp bot for instant ordering and dynamic GST invoice generation.

3. **Project Mald** (Enterprise Trading ERP):
   - Challenge: Managing multi-godown stock, handwritten waybills, and multi-currency overseas shipments with high error rates.
   - Solution: High-speed ERP with neural vision OCR parser for physical invoices, real-time FX currency converter (MVR, USD, EUR), and automated credit recovery reminders.

4. **NAS Design & Construction** (Architecture & Real Estate):
   - Challenge: Needed a high-end luxury digital showcase to attract high-net-worth real estate investors.
   - Solution: Interactive 3D architectural portfolio with GSAP smooth scroll and micro-interactions.

5. **NAS Internationals** (Luxury Travel & Visas):
   - Challenge: Complex visa verification procedures and document validation delays.
   - Solution: Supabase-powered applicant status portal with automated AI document pre-screening.

6. **Velvet Trunk** (Luxury E-Commerce & Pop-Up Expos):
   - Challenge: High friction and double-booking errors during luxury pop-up exhibition stall allocations.
   - Solution: Interactive real-time SVG stall floorplan selector and automated instant invoicing engine.

7. **Your Huckleberry** (Artisanal Bakery):
   - Challenge: Custom cake orders were lost across fragmented Instagram DMs.
   - Solution: Interactive digital cake customizer and direct checkout ordering hub.

8. **Arusuvai Arasu** (Banquet Estimation):
   - Challenge: 48-hour quoting turnaround caused lost event bookings.
   - Solution: 60-second automated banquet quotation calculator and instant PDF proposal generator.

## 7. AI & Humans — Manifesto & Free Student Workshops
Published at https://agenerativeslice.com/ai-for-humans/ :
- **Core thesis**: AI is a tool for human advancement and comfort, not a competitor for humans. "AI will not take your job. A person who knows how to use AI will take the job of a person who doesn't." Tools delete tasks, not people — the calculator, spreadsheet, ATM, Photoshop and search engine all triggered the same panic and the same outcome: adopters got promoted.
- **What stays human**: judgment, taste, empathy, ownership and the question. AI is a lever, an unsleeping intern, a mirror for thinking and a time machine.
- **Interactive Reframe Machine**: six common fears (job loss, starting late, marks-only studying, laziness, hype, non-technical background) each paired with an honest reframe and one ten-minute action step.
- **Founder's loops (taught verbatim in the workshop)**: Learning loop — explain like I'm new → quiz me until I break → teach it back. Building loop — describe the real problem → draft fast, test faster → verify like an owner. Psychology — confidence is a residue of shipped things; you are not your task; fear shrinks in motion.
- **Free workshops for freshers & college students**: five hands-on modules — (1) AI from absolute zero, (2) the learning loop applied to real subjects, (3) the problem-solving loop on-field, (4) the psychology of the lever, (5) proof-not-percentages portfolio project. ₹0 forever, no sales pitch, no experience required, free tools only, Tamil + English, small batches in-person in Chennai or live online, scheduled around semesters. Colleges can host on campus via https://agenerativeslice.com/contact/ . Registration: WhatsApp +91 78128 91494 or smdhussain@agenerativeslice.com.
